content_data.meeting_title: Feed Rendering Performance Optimization - Sprint Planning & Architecture Review
agenda_items: Plan sprint priorities for mobile app optimization work
Review accessibility compliance gaps in new UI components
Review current feed rendering bottlenecks and performance metrics
Address API rate limiting issues affecting user experience
Discuss proposed caching layer architecture for real-time content delivery
Evaluate third-party CDN integration options and cost implications
key_decisions: Agreed to deprecate legacy feed algorithm in favor of GraphQL-based approach
Selected Cloudflare as CDN provider for global content delivery optimization
Mandated automated performance testing for all pull requests affecting core feed functionality
Postponed real-time notification refactor to next sprint due to resource constraints
